noise_model: per-dataset nugget + exponential stationary kernel fitted to the far-field semivariogram of the referenced observations; every stationary draw is passed through the block-space far-field datum/ramp projection before it is added to the projected best-model prediction; fixed saved geometry and lambda
noiseless_refit_meaning: estimator bias: the smoothing penalty acting again (the reference projection is applied inside the estimator itself, so it no longer adds bias here)
interval_method: pivotal (basic bootstrap): refit errors about the noiseless refit, re-centred on the best fit; conditional data-noise dispersion under this simulator, not a full physical-parameter confidence interval; raw refit percentiles are the estimator dispersion, not an interval around the best fit
